en: Black‑and‑white photograph showing a formal procession of men in top hats and long coats walking along a broad street or square. A uniformed guard with a tall plume helmet stands at the left foreground holding a rifle. Grand neoclassical buildings line the right side; more classical façades and distant monuments appear in the background. The scene looks ceremonial, likely in a European capital in the early 20th century.
